notes.title: Co-op dungeon crawler Never Split the Party gets a big surprise update celebrating a million downloads
notes.notes:
The free to play online co-op dungeon crawler Never Split the Party from Legend Studio just had a massive update to celebrate one million downloads. Quite a surprise, since the last update to the game was back in 2022.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/co-op-dungeon-crawler-never-split-the-party-gets-a-big-surprise-update-celebrating-a-million-downloads/

notes.title: New Content Update: Engineer Class!
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings Fellow Vampire Hunters![/h2]

[h3]Now comes the Engineer...[/h3]
We are proud to introduce the [b]new Engineer class[/b]. He's focused on high damage, short range and comes with Split Shot by default! As he levels up and progresses [b]new Sentinel upgrades[/b] are unlocked so now you can drop turrets and buffs in rooms to destroy your enemies.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/801440/extras/outfit_show_5.png?t=1653687728[/img]

[h3]Change List[/h3]
Added new Engineer class ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/801440/Never_Split_the_Party_Fellowship/]Fellowship Unlock[/url] required by at least 1 player).
Added 10 new upgrades and items including new Sentinels that are placed like turrets and totems.
Disabled the minimum 2 player requirement by default.
Unobtainable items are now fully obtainable.
Updated to the latest game engine version with many stability improvements.
Other bug fixes and optimizations.

[h2]About Never Split the Party[/h2]
[b][url=https://legendstudio.com/never-split-the-party/]Never Split the Party[/url] is an ultra social rogue-like![/b] You're [b]one of four adventurers[/b]  entering an epic dungeon to take down the evil vampire known only as [b]The Countess[/b], who killed your parents and is now constantly bombarding you with insults.

[b]Explore[/b] a procedurally generated dungeon, [b]amass[/b] powerful upgrades, and [b]cooperate[/b] with your fellow adventures to [b]conquer[/b] and [b]crush[/b] the vile dungeon bosses!

Never Split the Party has over [b]120[/b] upgrades, [b]21[/b] magical potions, [b]28[/b] unique enemies, and over [b]425[/b] room designs spread among [b]5[/b] procedurally generated dungeon levels for maximum replayability!

[h3]Roles[/h3]
Each player has both a [b]role[/b] and a [b]character class[/b].

The [b]four unique roles[/b] in the game each provide vital info to the party.
 - [b]The Cartographer[/b] tracks the dungeon [b]maps[/b].
 - [b]The Treasurer[/b] tracks each players [b]inventory[/b].
 - [b]The Vitalist[/b] tracks each players [b]health[/b].
 - [b]The Loremaster[/b] tracks all knowledge of the [b]upgrades[/b].

If you were to be split from the party, say through an [b]Skeleton Wizard's[/b] teleportation or a [b]Punter[/b] that knocks you into the next room, then everyone else would lose access to your roles vital info until you're reunited.

[h3]Classes[/h3]
You'll also get to choose your [b]character class[/b]. The [b]Fighter[/b] and [b]Cleric[/b] classes are available for everyone (so that you can [b]always play with your friends[/b]).

Access to the other classes as well as [b]Challenge Modes (including PvP)[/b] and [b]Bonus Armor and Helmet Cosmetics[/b] are available with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/801440/Never_Split_the_Party_Fellowship/]Fellowship Unlock[/url].

[h2]About Legend Studio[/h2]
Founded in 1992, [url=https://legendstudio.com/]Legend Studio[/url] is an independent game developer, creating games such as [url=https://legendstudio.com/dragon-forge/]Dragon Forge[/url], [url=https://legendstudio.com/never-split-the-party/]Never Split the Party[/url], [url=https://legendstudio.com/a-legend-of-luca/]A Legend of Luca VR[/url], and [url=https://legendstudio.com/freecell-quest/]FreeCell Quest[/url].

notes.title: The Upgrade Update - 20 New Upgrades - 3 New Challenges
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6bUK-xcCSfc

[h1]The Upgrade Update[/h1]

In this update we added 20 new items! Ten of them are rechargeables. Most of the previous rechargeable items were locked behind achievements so this will help balance that out. The other ten are various stat upgrades to help balance things out as well as some new upgrades relating to potions.

[h1]New Challenge Modes[/h1]

We added a new Four Black Mages challenge that requires four heroes to play as mages.

Also, a Race Against Time challenge mode where the dungeon damages all players every few minutes. So the faster you move the better your chances. For the gamers that enjoy the speed runs.

Lastly, the Full Plate challenge gives you tons of health and damage but makes you move super slow. So some of the enemies might be unfair but you should have the health and damage to be able to deal with it.

[h1]Full Release Soon[/h1]

We're on the home stretch and will probably release the game from Early Access in the next week or two!

notes.title: The XP Update - New Leveling System - Epic Dungeons Challenge Mode
notes.notes:

[h1]The XP Update[/h1]

We added a new XP and leveling system to the game. Each class now has a level that gives you progress that is saved between runs. Reaching a new level gives you a slight increase to all of your stats and every 5 levels unlocks a new starting upgrade that can be chosen when you select your class. This allows the classes to be customizable and they can get very powerful. We will be increasing the difficulty of the game a bit to compensate.

[h1]Epic Dungeon Challenge[/h1]

Added a new challenge mode called Epic Dungeon. Several people have requested a mode where the dungeons are bigger and the game runs are much longer. This new challenge mode triples the size of each floor and adds a second hidden room to each floor!

notes.title: The Value Update - PvP Mode! Bonus Armor! Lower Price!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663529/893ee131e712f81f0fed69c95251b2887355bccd.png[/img]

[h1]The Value Update[/h1]
Since there's been occasional feedback about the price of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/801440/Never_Split_the_Party_Fellowship_Unlock/]Fellowship Unlock[/url] being too high :lunar2019shockedpig: we decided to focus on fixing that with this update. 

Thank you everyone for your support. We've really enjoyed working on this game and can't wait to see where it goes next! We are completely focused on delivering an insanely fun experience.

The best way to report feedback is thru the [url=https://discord.gg/bFNVWNV]Legend Studio Discord Channel[/url]

[h1]Lower Price[/h1]
We've lowered the base price of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/801440/Never_Split_the_Party_Fellowship_Unlock/]Fellowship Unlock[/url] to [b]$14.99![/b] We now have [b]seven classes[/b], [b]two challenges[/b] (with several more to come), your name in gold, and as an extra bonus, [b]17 new armor and helmets[/b] so that you can dungeon crawl in style.

[h1]Player Vs Player![/h1]
We've added a new Player vs. Player challenge mode. All challenge modes can be enabled by a single player with the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/801440/Never_Split_the_Party_Fellowship_Unlock/]Fellowship Unlock[/url] so you can enable PvP and Bomb Craft modes for your friends for free!

In PvP it's a free for all deathmatch. Each player kill is worth 1 point and each boss kill is worth 3 points. Don't let them run off with your upgrades! Enemy health is halved and pickup drops are doubled for extra fun.

[h1]Bonus Armor & Helmets[/h1]
As an extra bonus for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/801440/Never_Split_the_Party_Fellowship_Unlock/]Fellowship Unlock[/url] we've added a bunch of exclusive new armor and helmets so that you can dungeon crawl in style!

As part of this we redesigned and rebuilt the character edit GUI to be much more friendly and usable. You'll now get preview images which makes it easy to see what your options are and we even added a system that lets you rotate your character to see how it looks from different sides.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663529/ee102cf172448bf7c2efe3eaa00fb7e97ccdfd98.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663529/5d474975b19af1d1822dc88862ce43ef82caa39f.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663529/bd5cc1680e8064c887136978cf7ad1adeb9b36d5.png[/img]

[h1]Next Update Focus[/h1]
The focus of the next update will try to add several more Challenge Modes to add additional content and more replayability to the game.  Now that the Challenge Mode system is fully working we might be able to get five or more new challenges in the next update! Maybe even a daily run system as well. :lunar2019grinningpig:

We will also focus on adding a bunch more upgrades. We especially need more rechargeable upgrades as there's only a few that aren't locked behind character classes achievements. Adding more will cut down on the confusion around the green gems that recharge your mana.

Upgrades and Challenges are the big items that are keeping us from releasing out of early access.

notes.title: The Trinket Update! 14 New Items & Bomb Craft Challenge Added
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32663529/83d70f6f1c05051f282a7a666a069177b22a0158.png[/img]

[h1]Trinkets[/h1]

This new release adds 14 new upgrades available to find in the dungeon. We focused on adding trinket slot items that you can only have one at a time of. There were only about 3 available before so they were pretty rare and the slot would almost never be used. When you find an extra trinket it makes for interesting decisions on what to keep and the extra trinkets can be shared with the other members of the party, so they make the game a little more social.

With the 14 new upgrades our upgrade count is now at 92. Our goal before leaving early access is to have 120 upgrades available. About half of them will be unlocked thru achievements.

[h1]Challenge Mode[/h1]

This release also adds the new Bomb Craft challenge mode! In this mode all players start with Demolition (bombs as shots) and the treasure rooms are removed. Players often think this upgrade is OP but it's actually quite tricky since it can cause team damage.

The challenge modes can only be selected by someone who owns the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/801440/Never_Split_the_Party_Fellowship/]Fellowship unlock[/url]. So at least one of the 4 players will need to buy the game but then you can be a cool friend and unlock it for everyone.
